_doc: Biome tile set for blender/render_tiles.py. Tile ids match the content pack (tiles/crypt_tiles.json). One world unit = one tile; heights are in tile units. `texture` names a file in textures/<biome>/.
_pixelDoc: texturePixels: size each texture is shrunk to by `hdart pixel-textures` (about one texel per screen pixel at 32x16 tiles), with texColors colours each.
_rampDoc: Designed ramps (dark -> light). Shaded luminance is gradient-mapped onto the ramp of each pixel's material, so the biome reads as one limited palette (cf. the reference art in Architecture 9.1). Tiles pick a ramp per texture key in `ramps`; default is stone.

tiles._doc: cutaway version used for walls between the camera and the room
